title: Treaty of Radnot
text: The Treaty of Radnot was a bilateral treaty signed on 6 December 1656 during the Second Northern War in Radnot in Transylvania between Charles X Gustav of the Swedish Empire and George II Rákóczi, Prince of Transylvania. Sometimes, a wider set of agreements concluded in December 1656 between Sweden and its allies is "collectively called the Treaty of Radnot".
